title: Taste Cues
slide_intent: Use pictorial texture and color to suggest flavor, because food imagery helps people anticipate an experience before tasting.
strategic_value: The bright produce and small human figure can make Sweetgreen feel abundant and carefully prepared.
demonstration: A bowl of oversized painted vegetables surrounds a fine-line figure holding a large location pin; an orange handwritten note sits to the right.
practical_value: Compare the visual weight of vivid food and lightly drawn people when setting the illustration hierarchy.

content_islands.name: Food and figure
content_islands.spec: Center the filled bowl and the pin-bearing figure on the pale field.

content_islands.name: Annotation
content_islands.spec: Keep the orange note beside the illustration as process commentary, not an added brand headline.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying Taste Cues caption says the identity should feel as fresh and flavorful as the food.
reference_purposes.Expression: Saturated produce, a thin outlined person and a pale ground create different visual weights.

ingredient.name: Painted produce and outlined people
ingredient.role: Make ingredients prominent while showing human care.
ingredient.application: Give produce richer color and mass than the supporting line-drawn people, as this specimen does.
ingredient.scope: Observed illustration approach in this historical case study; no numerical size or color ratio is prescribed.
